Codified Decision Tree (CDT) Action Sequences
	

This dataset contains scene-action pairs derived from storylines, used to train and evaluate role-playing (RP) agents using the Codified Decision Trees (CDT) framework.

Paper: Deriving Character Logic from Storyline as Codified Decision Trees
